checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are data column sidecars received over P2P cryptographically verified via verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch before acceptance?

reachability.notes: Core security property: P2P peers are untrusted. Every sidecar must be cryptographically verified.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all P2P message handlers that receive data column sidecars. 2. Trace the code path from sidecar reception to verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch invocation. 3. Verify that NO code path exists where a sidecar can be accepted without passing through verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch. 4. Check that the batch verification validates ALL cells in the sidecar against their claimed KZG commitments. 5. Craft a forged sidecar with fabricated KZG commitments and cells, and verify it is rejected. 6. Test edge cases: empty sidecars, sidecars with partial valid cells, sidecars with mismatched commitment counts. 7. Verify error handling does not silently accept invalid sidecars on verification failure.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0037, Trust Boundary: tb-002. P2P peers are untrusted external actors. Accepting unverified sidecars allows an attacker to inject arbitrary data as if it were committed to by the block proposer. This is a critical security boundary where all incoming data must be cryptographically validated.

checklist.title: Supporting Check: Does verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch correctly validate all cells against claimed KZG commitments?

reachability.notes: Core security property: P2P peers are untrusted. Every sidecar must be cryptographically verified.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Review the implementation of verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch to ensure it processes ALL cells in the batch. 2. Verify that early-exit conditions do not skip validation of remaining cells on first success. 3. Check that the function returns false/error if ANY cell fails verification. 4. Test with a batch where only some cells are valid - ensure the entire batch is rejected. 5. Verify that commitment-to-cell binding is correctly enforced (cells cannot be swapped between commitments). 6. Check for potential integer overflow in batch size calculations that could skip cells.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0037. This check focuses on the correctness of the batch verification function itself, ensuring it provides the security guarantees expected at the trust boundary.

checklist.title: Supporting Check: Are forged sidecars with fabricated KZG commitments properly rejected at P2P validation layer?

reachability.notes: Core security property: P2P peers are untrusted. Every sidecar must be cryptographically verified.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Create a test sidecar with completely fabricated KZG commitments and cells (random data). 2. Submit via P2P gossip and verify it is rejected before being processed or stored. 3. Create a sidecar with valid-looking but incorrect KZG commitments. 4. Verify the P2P validation layer rejects the sidecar with appropriate error. 5. Check that rejected sidecars are not cached or partially processed. 6. Verify that the rejecting peer appropriately handles the malicious peer (e.g., scoring, disconnection). 7. Test replay attacks with previously-valid but now-stale sidecars.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0037, Actors: actor-p2p-peer, actor-validator-node. This check verifies the end-to-end rejection of forged data at the P2P trust boundary.
